main_analysis.title: paired multi-axis rationale-supervision by corruption-dose interaction

scope.cell_weighting: equal weight over all 12 family-by-nonzero-level cells and equal weight over five selected seed positions
scope.clean_baseline: verify all family level-0 arrays are exact, then count one clean baseline per seed/model

main_analysis.hypothesis: Across all twelve nonzero corruption cells, joint rationale supervision has at least 0.01 practical action-consistency advantage while action quality, joint rationale quality, and selective risk are each non-inferior at margin 0.01.
main_analysis.r_axis_limitation: R is a within-joint retention guardrail because action_only has no rationale head; it cannot establish a between-model R benefit.
main_analysis.unit_of_analysis: crossed training seed and source clip; images within each source clip are retained together

bootstrap.draw_source: reuse exact saved Round10 seed_position_draws and clip_position_draws
bootstrap.pairing: one shared seed and clip draw across every family, level, model, and axis
bootstrap.metric_recomputation: recompute macro-F1, tie-averaged AURC, and flip rate from expanded clip samples; never bootstrap aggregated cell means

PASS: D_C1 point estimate >= 0.01 and its q=0.0125 lower bound > 0
at least four of five seed-specific D_C1 values > 0
each of three family-specific D_C1 values >= -0.01
q=0.0125 lower bounds for D_A, D_R, and D_S are each > -0.01
gates.PARTIAL: all three C1 criteria pass but at least one of A, R, or S non-inferiority gates fails
gates.FAIL: any C1 point/CI, seed-count, or family guardrail fails

paper_consequence.PASS: supports dose-generalized RQ2-light consistency benefit with A/R/S guardrails under existing clean-action equivalence; does not imply causality, safety, faithfulness, or external validity
paper_consequence.PARTIAL: retain C1 benefit only and frame ARSC as exposing a cross-axis trade-off rather than identifying a globally superior model
paper_consequence.FAIL: restrict RQ2-light to its original fixed perturbation setting and remove broad rationale-supervision stability attribution; retain Round10 C1 sensitivity and A/R/S partial-fail findings

nonredundancy.round10: tested within-model monotone family-by-axis dose response, not a joint-versus-action supervision-by-dose interaction
nonredundancy.historical_rq2_light: used one existing perturbation per family and no A/R/S multi-axis guardrails, not all twelve nonzero dose cells

input_evidence.sufficiency: contains targets, predictions, confidence, errors, source-clip mapping, clip-level A/R/C1 sufficient statistics, curves, and safety diagnostics for five seeds, three families, five levels, and both action models
contains exact 5000 shared seed-position and source-clip-position draws

freeze_requirements_before_implementatio: freeze exact formulas, axis directions, cell weighting, margins, C1 guardrails, and PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL gate before computing outcomes
bind every input SHA and exact NPZ schema/shape/dtype allowlist
reuse exact saved Round10 bootstrap draws and shared pairing
freeze output artifact allowlist, numeric edge cases, finite-value policy, and one-shot stopping rule
do not select seeds, families, levels, models, or components after inspecting new effects
implement only this one analysis and obtain an independent pre-result review
claim_boundary: GO_FREEZE_ONE_ANALYSIS authorizes protocol freezing for exactly one existing-output statistical analysis. It does not authorize outcome calculation before freeze, new model inference, training, DAAD-X access, a second parallel analysis, or any scientific claim before formal results and independent post-result review.
